name: Question 4
problem: A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin $O$ with acceleration $a(t)=\operatorname{cos}⁡(4t)$, where $t\ge 0$ is the time. If the particle has position $x=\frac{1}{16}$ and velocity $v=\frac{1}{4}$ when $t=\frac{\pi }{8}$, calculate the position $x$ of the particle at time $t>0.$

Question 4
?

A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin O with acceleration a(t)=cos⁡(4t), where t≥0 is the time. If the particle has position x=116 and velocity v=14 when t=π8, calculate the position x of the particle at time t>0.

a
x(t)=116(1−cos⁡(4t))
b
x(t)=116(2−sin⁡(4t))
c
x(t)=116(1−2cos⁡(4t))
d
x(t)=116(1+sin⁡(4t))
e
x(t)=116(2+cos⁡(4t))
Submit
